inspection_summary: Inspected all 3,746 logical lines. The survey develops the finite-field Riemann hypothesis from point-count/zeta equivalences through Weil’s two positivity proofs, Weil cohomology, standard conjectures, motives, Deligne’s monodromy-and-Landau proof, and the global Hasse-Weil/automorphic outlook. Fifty-three reusable units capture the mathematical mechanisms; bibliography and the extraction-only final letter title are accounted for separately.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Identifies scope and source organization; no standalone mathematical unit.

sections_inspected.label: Weil’s 1940–41 trace strategy
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Tracks the replacement of transcendental trace by correspondence and intersection-theoretic positivity.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Develops Weil numbers, birational construction of Jacobians, Tate modules, characteristic polynomials, and Rosati positivity.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Generalizes the curve pattern to higher-dimensional rationality, duality, integrality, weights, and Betti numbers.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Axiomatizes cohomology, proves trace/rationality/integrality/functional equation, isolates the weight gap, and derives semisimplicity of numerical correspondences.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Explains why topology must be enlarged and how characteristic-sensitive cohomology theories realize the axioms.

sections_inspected.label: Standard conjectures and algebraic cycles
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States Lefschetz and Hodge types, derives RH consequences, and compares cycle equivalences with Hodge and Tate conjectures.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Constructs pure motives as universal cohomological receptacles and surveys polarizations, absolute Hodge, rational Tate, and almost-algebraic classes.

sections_inspected.label: Deligne’s proof
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Develops the Landau–Rankin clue, trace formula, big monodromy, tensor-power amplification, main lemma, and Lefschetz-pencil induction.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Moves from local finite-field factors to global functional equations, automorphic functoriality, and the motivic Taniyama group.

sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Notes the independent Stepanov–Bombieri elementary route and closes the narrative.

accepted_units.title: Curve zeta functions turn RH into Frobenius spectral and point-count bounds
accepted_units.why_material: Connects Euler products, rationality, functional equation, inverse roots, and square-root cancellation in both directions.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the function-field/curve dictionary and the short converse argument.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent but equations and prose are recoverable from the text layer.

accepted_units.title: Degree positivity proves the elliptic-curve bound
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how a characteristic polynomial is controlled by nonnegativity of degrees of m−nα, then specializes to Frobenius.
accepted_units.context_note: Early-work context is included because it motivates correspondences in higher genus.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Tate-module formulas are legible; no external reconstruction is needed.

accepted_units.title: Correspondences replace missing first-homology traces
accepted_units.why_material: Recasts fixed-point counts as a trace problem and identifies positivity of X composed with its transpose as the key lemma.
accepted_units.context_note: Preserves the passage from Hurwitz’s formula to Frobenius.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Mostly prose with recoverable displayed trace identities.

accepted_units.title: Two realizations of Weil’s positivity invariant
accepted_units.why_material: Contrasts torsion on the Jacobian with intersection theory on C×C while preserving the same trace-positivity target.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes Weil’s reason for abandoning the ad hoc torsion-only presentation.

accepted_units.title: Divisors, intersection products, Riemann–Roch, and adjunction
accepted_units.why_material: Supplies the reusable geometric language needed to turn correspondences into numerical inequalities.
accepted_units.context_note: Kept as one setup block because later proofs jointly depend on these notions.

accepted_units.title: Hodge index converts orthogonality into negativity
accepted_units.why_material: Derives a one-positive-direction signature from Riemann–Roch and makes negative definiteness on an orthogonal complement available.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the index criterion and corollaries used immediately afterward.

accepted_units.title: Castelnuovo–Severi defect as a positive quadratic form
accepted_units.why_material: Specializes Hodge index to a product of curves and polarizes the resulting defect inequality.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the graph computation needed for Frobenius.

accepted_units.title: Curve RH from defect positivity and fixed points
accepted_units.why_material: Identifies rational points with diagonal–Frobenius intersections and shows correspondence trace positivity is exactly defect nonnegativity.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes composition conventions so the trace identity is self-contained.

accepted_units.title: Weil’s determinant proof of strict correspondence positivity
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how zeros and poles of a determinant built from canonical differentials bound coincidence intersections, then descends through a cover.
accepted_units.context_note: Retains the generic-Galois step that extends the special divisor argument.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: One determinant is typographically damaged at its closing parenthesis, but the prose recovers its role.

accepted_units.title: From Castelnuovo’s special inequality to the general Hodge-index explanation
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how later surface Riemann–Roch exposed Weil’s inequality as a specialization of a general signature theorem.
accepted_units.context_note: Historical attributions are retained only where they clarify the mechanism’s scope.

accepted_units.title: Alternative curve proofs and transfer to exponential sums
accepted_units.why_material: Separates proof variants by their geometric prerequisites and records the trace-of-Frobenius bridge to exponential-sum bounds.
accepted_units.context_note: Short paired subsection; both parts compare reuse of the same core mechanism.

accepted_units.title: RH-driven foundations liberate varieties from fixed embeddings
accepted_units.why_material: Explains why constructing Jacobians and validating intersections forced abstract varieties, and why that framework was later superseded.
accepted_units.context_note: The long review quotation is supporting evidence for the foundational tradeoff.

accepted_units.title: Weil numbers classify finite-field simple abelian varieties up to isogeny
accepted_units.why_material: Connects Frobenius absolute values to isogeny classes and endomorphism division algebras.
accepted_units.context_note: Starts with the Tate homomorphism theorem context needed for the classification.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula (9) is legible though notation is dense.

accepted_units.title: Cyclotomic towers as a number-field analogue of constant-field extensions
accepted_units.why_material: Records an early conceptual transfer from Frobenius on divisor classes to an operator on inverse limits of class groups.
accepted_units.context_note: The claim is explicitly heuristic in Weil’s letter.

accepted_units.title: A partial divisor-class law constructs the Jacobian birationally
accepted_units.why_material: Uses Riemann–Roch generic uniqueness to define a birational group, then completes it to a group variety.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes both general birational-group theorem and its symmetric-product realization.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formulas and rational-map arrows are recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Degree polynomials define characteristic polynomials algebraically
accepted_units.why_material: Replaces complex-lattice linear algebra by intersection-theoretic degree, producing an intrinsic characteristic polynomial over arbitrary fields.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the theorem-of-the-cube input and polynomiality argument.

accepted_units.title: Tate modules realize the intrinsic characteristic polynomial
accepted_units.why_material: Proves finite-rank control of homomorphisms and identifies the degree-defined polynomial with the ℓ-adic action.
accepted_units.context_note: The divisibility lemma and discreteness argument are necessary support.

accepted_units.title: Rosati positivity forces Frobenius eigenvalues onto the weight circle
accepted_units.why_material: Builds a positive adjoint, derives semisimplicity and conjugate absolute values, then proves π†π=q using the Weil pairing.
accepted_units.context_note: Ends with the direct deduction of curve RH from the Jacobian.

accepted_units.title: Finite-field abelian Frobenius package
accepted_units.why_material: Collects integrality, ℓ-independence, point counts, weight, and reciprocal symmetry into one reusable package.
accepted_units.context_note: This summary is distinct from the preceding proof and useful as an interface statement.

accepted_units.title: The Weil conjectures separate rationality, duality, integrality, weights, and topology
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how diagonal hypersurface counts suggested a higher-dimensional package and why cohomology explains only part of it heuristically.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the fixed-point functional-equation heuristic and Weil’s caution about conjecture.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Some extracted combinatorial formulas are cramped, but the five conjectural clauses are clear.

accepted_units.title: Abelian exterior powers and rational recurrences model the conjectures
accepted_units.why_material: Exhibits cohomological degrees through products of Frobenius roots and interprets rationality as a finite linear recurrence.
accepted_units.context_note: Compact bridge from the conjectures to cohomology.

accepted_units.title: Weil cohomology axioms encode duality, products, and algebraic cycles
accepted_units.why_material: Specifies the minimal functorial package that transports intersection data into finite-dimensional graded linear algebra.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes pushforward as the adjoint supplied by Poincaré duality.

accepted_units.title: Lefschetz trace identifies intersections with alternating cohomological traces
accepted_units.why_material: Derives the fixed-point trace formula from the graph class, Künneth decomposition, and dual bases.
accepted_units.context_note: Complete proof span retained.

accepted_units.title: Endomorphism algebras forbid universal rational, real, or p-adic coefficients
accepted_units.why_material: Uses a supersingular elliptic curve’s nonsplit quaternion algebra to show why Weil realizations must be coefficient-sensitive.
accepted_units.context_note: Short argument depends on the finite-field abelian classification already developed.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose and algebra notation are clear.

accepted_units.title: Weil cohomology proves rationality, integrality, and the functional equation
accepted_units.why_material: Combines trace/determinant identities, closed-point integrality, and Poincaré duality to establish W1–W3.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the Hankel and ℓ-adic pole arguments because they close the coefficient claims.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: A few overbars are lost in extraction, but the prose fixes the intended coefficient fields.

accepted_units.title: Weights prevent cancellation and canonically separate cohomological factors
accepted_units.why_material: Explains precisely why W4 is not merely another consequence: purity makes degree factors coprime and realization-independent.
accepted_units.context_note: Read against the preceding W1–W3 proof.

accepted_units.title: Weil cohomology makes numerical correspondences finite-dimensional and semisimple
accepted_units.why_material: Passes from adequate equivalence and cycle pairings to a correspondence algebra whose radical vanishes by trace nilpotence.

accepted_units.representation_dependency: Some direct-sum typography is degraded, but maps and argument are recoverable.

accepted_units.title: Grothendieck topologies enlarge locality enough for étale cohomology
accepted_units.why_material: Shows how locally isotrivial covers, categorical coverings, sheaves, and comparison with topology answer the missing higher-cohomology problem.
accepted_units.context_note: Historical narrative is retained where it explains each conceptual enlargement.

accepted_units.title: ℓ-adic limits turn étale torsion cohomology into a Weil theory
accepted_units.why_material: Explains the inverse-limit construction, compact-support trace formula, and comparison that yields W1–W3 and stable Betti numbers.
accepted_units.context_note: The intervening historical testimony is supporting context rather than part of this unit.

accepted_units.title: Algebraic de Rham cohomology recovers analytic cohomology in characteristic zero
accepted_units.why_material: Shows that hypercohomology of algebraic differentials gives a Weil realization compatible with complex topology.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes Grothendieck’s algebraic/analytic comparison.

accepted_units.title: Infinitesimal thickening leads to crystalline and de Rham–Witt cohomology
accepted_units.why_material: Tracks failed characteristic-p candidates, the divided-power repair, and the resulting computable p-adic Weil realization.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes why p-adic cohomology retains special value for p-phenomena.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: One direct-sum layout is degraded; prose preserves the comparison.

accepted_units.context_note: The curve unitary argument motivates the higher-dimensional condition.

accepted_units.why_material: Builds the star operator and Hodge–Riemann positivity, then normalizes an endomorphism to a unitary operator whose eigenvalues have the required weights.

accepted_units.title: Hodge-type positivity turns standard conjectures into RH
accepted_units.why_material: Combines positive primitive intersection, an algebraic star operator, Weil forms, and Frobenius adjoints to recover the weight conclusion.
accepted_units.context_note: Also records semisimplicity as a distinct consequence.

accepted_units.title: Cycle equivalences form a one-way hierarchy with conjectural collapses
accepted_units.why_material: Distinguishes rational, algebraic, homological, numerical, and smash-nilpotent equivalence and shows why the chosen quotient controls the conjectures.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes known counterexamples and the standard-conjecture implication hom=num.

accepted_units.title: Hodge and Tate conjectures feed the standard conjectures
accepted_units.why_material: Maps the logical relations among algebraicity of classes, Lefschetz type, Hodge type, and generation of motives over finite fields.
accepted_units.context_note: The final paragraph is explicitly a proof sketch with conditional steps.

accepted_units.title: Motives universalize cohomology by splitting projectors and inverting Tate
accepted_units.why_material: Constructs correspondences, pseudo-abelian completion, effective motives, and Tate twists so every compatible Weil cohomology factors through one category.

accepted_units.representation_dependency: Category formulas are legible despite tight extraction.

accepted_units.title: Numerical motives become semisimple tannakian and polarized
accepted_units.why_material: Connects numerical equivalence, Künneth projectors, fibre functors, duality, and Weil forms into an abstract cohomology framework.
accepted_units.context_note: Conditional dependence on the standard conjectures is explicit.

accepted_units.why_material: Embeds one hypersurface in a pencil, uses symplectic big monodromy to locate poles of even tensor powers, and applies Landau to force exact weight.

accepted_units.representation_dependency: One denominator layout is degraded; surrounding prose identifies each determinant.

accepted_units.why_material: Abstracts the curve-family argument and shows how arbitrarily high powers erase a fixed exponent error, then transfers middle-degree control to all degrees.

accepted_units.why_material: Defines good-prime factors and the completed rth zeta factor, separating known local convergence from conjectural global continuation and symmetry.

accepted_units.representation_dependency: The displayed Euler product is cramped but the prose enumerates all factors.

accepted_units.title: Automorphic identification is the proposed route to global Hasse-Weil continuation
accepted_units.why_material: Explains known modular/CM cases, the functoriality principle, and Langlands’s proposed feedback from automorphic tools to cycles and motives.

accepted_units.context_note: The source only states the route and references, so no proof details are inferred.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: One positivity pattern across four proof languages
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Degree, intersection defect, Rosati adjoints, and Weil forms are successive representations of the same strategy: construct a positive involution or quadratic form, relate Frobenius to its adjoint, and force spectral size.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The source establishes these instances and analogies, not a formal equivalence theorem among all four frameworks.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: What cohomology proves before purity
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Duality plus trace formalism explains rationality, integrality, and functional equation, while weights are the extra input that prevents cancellation and identifies degreewise factors.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This synthesis applies to smooth projective varieties in the stated Weil-cohomology setting.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Coefficient obstruction motivates multiple realizations
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: A single rational or real Weil theory is obstructed, so étale, de Rham, and crystalline theories should be viewed as complementary coefficient-sensitive realizations rather than redundant constructions.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The obstruction cited is specific to certain coefficient fields and does not classify all possible realizations.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Standard conjectures as an algebraicity interface for positivity
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The standard conjectures seek exactly the algebraic projectors and positive primitive pairings needed to transport the Kähler unitary argument into finite characteristic.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: They remain conjectural in the generality described; Deligne’s proof does not prove them.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Motives compress realization-independent structure
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Passing from cycle equivalences to projectors, Tate twists, fibre functors, and algebraically defined class enlargements separates universal structure from any one cohomology realization.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Several categorical properties depend on numerical equivalence or standard/Hodge/Tate conjectures.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Deligne’s route replaces unavailable cycle positivity with analytic positivity plus monodromy
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Nonnegative tensor-power traces, control of global poles, and big geometric monodromy provide an alternative weight mechanism that avoids proving the standard conjectures.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The source sketches technical inputs such as vanishing cycles and the Kazhdan–Margulis theorem rather than proving them.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Local finite-field purity feeds a distinct global automorphic problem
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Deligne’s local weight theorem controls Euler-factor convergence, but global continuation and functional equation are transferred to automorphic or motivic identifications rather than following from local purity alone.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The automorphic identification is conjectural in general and known examples do not establish universality.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: The curve case is a laboratory, not a single canonical proof
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Elliptic degree arguments, surface intersections, determinant estimates, Jacobian positivity, and Stepanov’s method reach the same curve bound with different prerequisites and downstream reach.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The source notes that elementary RH proofs do not automatically yield polynomiality of Artin L-functions.
